headline: Samsung Executive Claims New Foldable Design Now Capable of Automatically Sorting Dad Jokes by Punchline Quality
body:
The engineering team at the smartphone manufacturer has announced that their latest flagship foldable device now features a dedicated 'Paternal Processing Unit' specifically designed to organize and rank family-friendly humor. This new software update ensures that every user’s collection of puns is neatly cataloged based on their propensity to cause groans or eye-rolls among teenagers.

'We noticed that our users were struggling to keep track of which jokes were appropriate for dinner table conversations versus those meant for WhatsApp groups,' said a senior hardware developer speaking from the brand's innovation lab. 'The device now utilizes a sophisticated neural network to detect the exact density of a dad joke, moving the most 'cringeworthy' material into a secure, hidden folder labeled 'Legacy Material' to protect the user's social standing.'

Market analysts suggest that this feature is a direct response to the shifting demographic of foldable phone enthusiasts. While younger users are drawn to the device's multi-tasking capabilities, the inclusion of an automated punchline-correction tool has reportedly converted a significant number of former minimalist smartphone users who were previously tired of manually curating their comedic output.
caption: Samsung's new AI update wants to ensure your puns are never unorganized again. From spreadsheets to dad jokes, productivity is evolving. #Samsung #TechNews #DadJokes #Innovation (satire)
